name: cc-antigravity-plugin
description: Agentic coding assistant powered by the direct Antigravity CLI (AGY) bridge. Use the command/skill path or the antigravity-coder subagent for implementation; the bundled antigravity-agent is read-only analysis only.

requiresExternalTool.name: agy
requiresExternalTool.description: Antigravity CLI (AGY) 1.1.8+ — Google's long-context agentic coding terminal

default_model.title: Default AGY Model
default_model.description: Optional AGY model slug or alias. Leave blank to preserve the user's current AGY /model. The bridge discovers valid models dynamically with `agy models`; `auto` selects a tier from the newest Flash family.

default_effort.title: Default AGY Reasoning Effort
default_effort.description: Optional native reasoning effort: low, medium, or high. Leave blank to let AGY/model defaults decide.

timeout.title: Default Timeout
timeout.description: Default timeout for AGY print mode, for example 3m, 300s, or 5m0s.

coding_policy.title: Coding-Delegation Policy
coding_policy.description: When on, a SessionStart hook injects the plugin's coding-delegation policy as session context (delegate file work to AGY via the skill/command or antigravity-coder, --parallel for big front-end, model guidance, and the AskUserQuestion image flow). Set to off/false/0/no to suppress injection.
